editorial.evidence: Re-review against all 27 captured sections, split into 46 coverage rows. The previous version kept the tables and the 13 checks but thinned most prose: the two-minute spoken answer, two of four follow-up answers, the section 8 cost-asymmetry argument and its two quotes, the data_access_granted gate, the Snorkel/synthetic/intake quotes, the strata list, the datasheet estimate, shadow-mode definition and 11 of 15 takeaways were missing, and it misquoted '38% of claims' as new claims. I restored each, split section 8 and 11 into their own walkthrough steps (8, 9) and failure modes into its own dive, rewrote the brief around the verbatim prompt with an illustrative claim trace, added a labelled kappa example and worked sample-size arithmetic (rechecked: 1004.8 and 0.112), and replaced generic figure alt text with node-accurate text. Duplicate prose restatements of the FR/NFR tables were removed. Source inconsistencies resolved in text (2026-11-16): 'lower half' of the picture versus flowcharts that run top to bottom → the prose now describes the flowcharts as drawn (repair stages first, decision layer after), since the figures are hashed originals; 'agree about half the time beyond chance' for κ = 0.52 → the step 9 quote now says the adjusters reach about half of the agreement possible beyond chance, which is what κ = (0.52) means by its definition in step 4.
